newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Leaked report won't hit PNG relations -Australia.
newsitem.headline: Leaked report won't hit PNG relations -Australia.

text.p: Australian foreign minister Alexander Downer said on Thursday a leaked secret government report critical of its South Pacific neighbours would not harm relations with Papua New Guinea (PNG).

Downer, on a three-day visit to Sri Lanka, declined to say if his government would publicly apologise to its neighbours over the 93-page report, which was scathing of several regional economies and the personal habits of some of their ministers.
He said Australian Treasurer Peter Costello had already answered questions on that subject on a number of occasions.
"I'm not to comment any further on the matter today."
Asked whether relations with PNG would be affected by the report's comments on its newly appointed foreign minister, Chris Haiveta, Downer replied: "No."

The leaked report -- marked 'AUSTEO', or Australian Eyes Only -- was prepared for Costello as briefing for a summit of economic ministers of the South Pacific Forum earlier this month in the tropical resort of Cairns.
It was left on a table in a public area at the summit where it was obtained by Reuters.
It was scornful of many regional politicians, including Papua New Guinea former deputy prime minister Haiveta.
On Wednesday, Haiveta was given a raft of portfolios in the newly elected PNG government of Bill Skate including foreign affairs and commerce and industry.
Skate, the governor of Port Moresby district, swept to power on Tuesday at the head of a mixed coalition of parties.
